newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli police shoot two Arabs at roadblock.
newsitem.headline: Israeli police shoot two Arabs at roadblock.

text.p: Border policemen shot and wounded two Arabs at an Israeli military roadblock between Jerusalem and the West Bank town of Bethlehem on Sunday, police said.
Security forces had thrown protective rings around Israeli cities following a deadly suicide bombing in Tel Aviv on Friday and threats of more to come.

"An Arab arrived from the direction of Bethlehem. A border policeman at the roadblock asked him to identify himself. the Arab presented an identity card and in the words of the policeman began to flee in the direction of Bethlehem," a police spokesman said.

"The policeman ordered him to stop and in his words fired two warning shots in the air. The Arab entered a Subaru vehicle in which three to four more Arabs were waiting. The policeman fired two more shots at the vehicle.

"His comrade at the roadblock also fired two shots. Two of the Arabs in the car were wounded lightly to moderately and taken to hospital ... another Arab who was in the vehicle fled," the spokesman said.

The Palestinian Moslem militant group Hamas claimed responsibility for killing three Israeli women in Friday's suicide bombing of a Tel Aviv cafe. On Saturday Hamas threatened to launch further attacks if building continued on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
